p: The beauty of a session up on the Westgate roof is how much of Oxford sits within walking distance. Oxford Castle and Prison is just across the road, with tours that tell the darker side of the city's story, and Christ Church, with its famous college and cathedral, is only a few minutes away down St Aldate's.

Make it a full day by doing the history in the morning and the darts later on. The Ashmolean Museum is free and packed with treasures, the Covered Market off the High Street is great for a nose round and a bite, and the Radcliffe Camera and Bodleian Library make a classic photo stop on the walk back.

Getting there is easy. Oxford railway station is around ten minutes' walk away, and the city's Park and Ride buses are a sensible shout if you're driving in, because parking in the centre can be a faff. The Westgate does have its own car park if you'd rather keep it simple.
First-time throwers, don't panic. Stand side-on, keep your elbow steady and aim to follow through. Then let the games do the rest.
